errors.evidence: The description fails to state what the chart represents, which is the 'Forecast values of bank equity to total assets for Second Group banks - foreign-owned banks' according to the provided caption. It only offers a generic statement: 'The figure illustrates changes in values over time.'

The description is critically incomplete. After describing the axes, it only identifies one of the six banks ('Райфайзен банк') and its color, then stops. It fails to describe the trend for this line and completely omits the other five data series ('Алианц Банк България', 'Ти Би Ай Банк', 'ПроКредит Банк', 'БАКБ', 'Токуда') and their corresponding trends and values.
